title: SAP Landscape: Full Stack Overview (OS, Oracle, SAP)
description: One view of the operating system, the Oracle database and SAP NetWeaver, built around the ten alert scenarios of the runbook.

panels.title: APP | Short dumps, last 15 min (ST22)
panels.description: Alert when more than 20. Investigate system-wide code or connection failures. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: APP | Work processes busy (DIA / BTC)
panels.description: Alert at 100%: users face lockouts, background chain halts. Source: ABAPGetWPTable (SM50).

panels.title: APP | Update queue (proxy)
panels.description: Only a proxy: requests waiting in the update dispatcher queue. Cancelled (V2) updates and a delay over 30 minutes need SM13 data. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: APP | Enqueue locks (count)
panels.description: Count only. Lock age above 24 hours (SM12) cannot be read from SAPControl. Needs an exporter on the central services instance. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: DB | Archive log filesystem used
panels.description: Alert above 90%. Critical: Oracle freezes at 100%. Directory /oracle/<SID>/oraarch.

panels.title: DB | Tablespace used (max)
panels.description: Alert above 95%. The exporter's used percent is measured against the maximum size, so auto-extend is taken into account.

panels.title: DB | Last backup return code
panels.description: Alert at return code 2 or higher (BRBACKUP, BRARCHIVE). Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: DB | Disk read wait (sequential/scattered)
panels.description: Alert above 20 ms: disk I/O bottleneck. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: OS | Swap page-out rate
panels.description: Pages swapped out per second (vmstat pswpout). Any sustained value means the OS is short of RAM. The red limit of 100 is an example: set it to your ST06 threshold.

panels.title: OS | /usr/sap and /oracle/<SID> used (max)
panels.description: Alert above 95%: crash risk or no space for logs and traces.

options.content:
**Green** = fine. **Yellow** = approaching the alert limit. **Red** = the alert condition from the runbook is met.

Tiles that show **No data** are scenarios whose data is not collected yet. They are listed with the way to collect them in the last row.

Variables at the top: **Host** (instance label) and **SID** (used in the Oracle file system paths).

panels.title: Paging: swap in/out and page in/out
panels.description: ST06 style paging view. Swap out is the important one.

panels.title: Oracle up and sessions
panels.description: oracledb_up is 1 when the exporter can connect to the database.

panels.title: Sessions and processes used % of limit
Disk read wait per I/O (ms)
panels.description: Alert line at 20 ms. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: Backup return codes
panels.description: BRBACKUP and BRARCHIVE return codes. Alert from 2. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: SAP process status
panels.description: GetProcessList from sapstartsrv. Details: dashboard SAPControl Exporter.

panels.title: Update queue (UPD, UP2)
panels.description: Proxy for the update backlog. Cancelled updates and delay in minutes need SM13 data.

panels.title: System log: red entries (SM21)
panels.description: Indirect signal only. It does not count ST22 short dumps.

panels.title: Enqueue lock table entries
panels.description: Needs the exporter for the central services instance. Shows 'No data' until the data source described in the last row exists.

panels.title: Scenarios that need a data source

options.content:
| Scenario | Why it is empty | What to add |
|---|---|---|
| Short dumps (ST22) | SAPControl has no dump counter | Custom Oracle metric from table SNAP (`oracledb_sap_snap_short_dumps_15m`), draft in `oracledb-custom-metrics.toml`. Basis must confirm schema, time zone and the SEQNO rule |
| Disk read wait | The default Oracle exporter has no wait-event latency | Custom metric from V$SYSTEM_EVENT (`oracledb_system_event_*`), draft in `oracledb-custom-metrics.toml` |
| Backup failure (BRBACKUP, BRARCHIVE) | Return codes are in SAP/BR*Tools logs, not in any current metric | Basis/DBA to say where the return code is stored (DB13 log table or BR*Tools log files), then expose it as `sap_backup_last_return_code{function}` |
| Update backlog and cancelled V2 updates | Only the queue length is available | Data from SM13 (update request table) as a custom metric; ask Basis for the table and status values |
| Enqueue lock age over 24 h | The lock table call returns no time stamp | Data from SM12 or the enqueue server; also an exporter on the central services instance for the lock count |
